conviction_note: Q3 2026 crypto prices (BTC about +43%, ETH about +57-71%, SOL about +48%) imply a large mark-to-market swing to profit against a consensus that still expects a loss (-$0.06 Benzinga, -$0.13 Earnings Whispers). The beat is inferred from public prices, not taken from a company number, and this name has sold two of its last three prints. The stock is also trading on CoreWeave credit stress, which the release cannot settle. So p_up is a mild lean of 56 on an 11% absolute move (option-implied 11.34%). The findings sum to +1.6, close to the scaled +1.32; they differ only by rounding of the lean.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS is a loss of $0.06 on revenue of $9.04B per Benzinga's preview (https://www.tradingview.com/news/benzinga:93a95603f094b:0-galaxy-digital-earnings-are-less-than-a-week-away-here-s-what-investors-should-know/, about 2026-10-22). Earnings Whispers shows a loss of $0.13 (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/GLXY). Other figures conflict: Benzinga's forecast page reads +$0.05 on $15.76B, an undated Benzinga figure reads +$0.14 on $14.40B, and Maxim's August figure is -$0.44. The bar is therefore disputed. The two latest sources agree only that a small loss is expected, so every size here is capped. print_vs_bar_pct is measured on revenue: I expect gross revenue at or slightly below the $9.04B bar, since CEX spot volume fell 14% QoQ. EPS on the inference here would be well above every bar, roughly +$0.25 to +$0.60, but that is a percent of a negative bar and is not expressed here. There is no company guidance beyond Helios Phase I at about $80M a quarter.
positioning_check: FINRA short interest was 32.63M shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, 6.73 days to cover, up from 27.16M on 08-14 and 30.80M on 09-15 (https://equibles.com/stocks/glxy/shortinterest). That is 8.3% of total shares, but about 17% of the roughly 195M Class A shares, with insiders owning 51.5% (MarketBeat 2026-10-16). Part of this short is likely convert-arb hedging: the May 2026 resale prospectus registers 36.4M shares underlying exchangeable notes held by Linden, MMCAP, Voya and others. The 10-15 settlement is not yet published. Skew is -1.02 vol points (balanced, slight call bid) and put/call OI is 1.09. The straddle implies 12.9% and the event-implied move is 11.34%. The stock is -33% over 20 days and -62% from its 52-week high, sitting 5% above its 52-week low. The skew does not lean against a positive sign, and a crowded, rising short argues against sizing negatives large.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 crypto prices rose sharply: BTC +42.9% (about $58.5k to $83-86k), ETH about +57-71%, SOL about +48% ($80 to $118). Against Galaxy's Q2 Treasury & Corporate net digital asset and investment exposure of $1.16B, which posted -$42M adjusted gross profit in Q2 when BTC fell 14%, this implies a swing to a large segment gain, plausibly +$150-300M. That would put Q3 net income and EPS well above a consensus that still expects a loss of $0.06-$0.13.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 had ETH +66% and Treasury & Corporate adjusted gross profit of $408M, with net income $505M and adjusted EPS $1.12; the stock moved +8.1% close-to-close (baseline 2025-10-21). Q2 2026 beat on EPS (-$0.09 vs a -$0.36 or -$0.05 bar), but revenue missed, and the stock moved -13.89%. Q4 2025 was a mark-driven loss and the stock moved -16.87%.
findings.why_not_priced: Every published bar still models a Q3 loss: -$0.06 (Benzinga, about 10-22) and -$0.13 (Earnings Whispers). The FY consensus is -$0.87 (MarketBeat 10-16). If the sell side had marked Q3 crypto, Q3 EPS estimates would be positive and well above zero. The stock has fallen 33% in 20 days on CoreWeave and AI-credit news, so the backward-looking mark is not what holders are trading.
findings.independence: ETH +70.8% in Q3 2026 (https://phemex.com/news/article/ethereum-posts-strongest-quarterly-gain-since-q1-2021-with-708-q3-rise-98634) and SOL +48% (https://247wallst.com/investing/cryptocurrency/2026/10/02/how-high-can-solana-go-in-2026-after-a-48-quarter/). Q2 segment exposure is from the company's Q2 release (https://finviz.com/news/377387/galaxy-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results). This is a proxy: Galaxy has not disclosed Q3 holdings or hedges.

findings.finding: Q3 is the first full quarter of Helios Phase I. All 133 MW of critical IT load was in service by 30 June, and the company guided to about $80M of quarterly leasing revenue at a project-level adjusted EBITDA margin above 90% from Q3. In Q2 the Data Centers segment had $20M adjusted gross profit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 was the first Helios revenue quarter: $20M adjusted gross profit and $11M adjusted EBITDA, and the stock moved -13.89%, driven by the revenue miss headline. There is no earlier history on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: This sits inside company guidance and is largely priced. Its only incremental value is confirming that CoreWeave paid in full during a credit scare. If the market trusted that payment, GLXY would not have fallen in step with CoreWeave's bonds.
findings.independence: StoneX notes Phase I delivered 133 MW in July and generated first revenue (https://theblock.co/news/markets/2026-10-19-galaxy-digital-glxy-stonex-buy-coreweave-helios-ai-data-center-421045). This shares the company document with the guidance.

findings.finding: CoreWeave, sole tenant for the first 800 MW at Helios, is under credit stress. Its stock fell about 25% in the week to 10-16, its 2031/2032 bond yields touched 15-16%, and its debt was $35.6-51.6B at June. Galaxy funded Phase II with $3.5B of 9.875% secured notes, so the call will be dominated by counterparty questions the release cannot settle.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior print with a tenant-credit scare. The stock fell about 30% in two weeks on this line before the print (Benzinga and The Block, 10-19).
findings.why_not_priced: Most of this is priced: the stock is -33% over 20 days and options imply 11%. It stays a negative because the release can confirm CoreWeave paid but cannot remove the risk. Any hedged wording, schedule slip on Phase II (data halls from Q2 2027) or lease renegotiation in Q&A would add to it. If it were fully priced, GLXY would have stabilised as CoreWeave bonds rebounded on 10-15; it fell a further 15% after.
findings.independence: Galaxy's sole-tenant exposure and StoneX's defence are at https://theblock.co/news/markets/2026-10-19-galaxy-digital-glxy-stonex-buy-coreweave-helios-ai-data-center-421045. Morgan Stanley cut its target $48 to $43 on AI-credit concerns (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/mara-riot-glxy-price-targets-cut-at-morgan-stanley-on-ai-credit-concerns-analyst-still-sees-over-100-upside/cZD6HOyRBn9). Financing check: the notes fund contracted Phase II ($10.4B minimum lease payments), so the financing is a ramp, not distress. The risk is the tenant, not the debt.

findings.finding: Citi upgraded GLXY to Buy on 10-13 (target $26 to $28), citing better Helios I economics and a possible Helios II tenant announcement within six months. A new, non-CoreWeave tenant announced with the print would directly answer the concentration fear.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The August 2025 CoreWeave Helios commitments moved the stock up materially. No print-day tenant announcement exists in the baseline history.
findings.why_not_priced: The probability of an announcement inside this window is low, so it carries little in a stock priced on CoreWeave single-tenant risk. If a second tenant were expected, the stock would not trade 5% off its 52-week low.
findings.independence: Galaxy has acquired land for a second Texas campus at McGregor (The Block, 10-19, same URL as finding 3). There is no tenant confirmation from any source.

findings.finding: Short interest rose from 27.2M shares (08-14) to 32.6M (09-30), 6.73 days to cover, about 17% of Class A shares. The stock fell a further 33% after that settlement, so a positive headline (a profit swing, CoreWeave paid) meets a crowded and growing short.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no measured squeeze on a past GLXY print. Days to cover was 3.7-4.8 at the prior prints, so it is higher now.
findings.why_not_priced: Skew is balanced (-1.02), so options are not paying up for upside. If the squeeze were anticipated, calls would be bid over puts. Part of the short is exchangeable-note hedging, which does not need to cover, and that is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: The exchangeable notes underlying 36.4M shares are in the resale prospectus (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001859392/000162828026037301/galaxy-resalesx3424b3.htm). That source cuts against this finding and is already netted into the size.

findings.finding: Galaxy's gross revenue tracks spot notional, and centralized-exchange spot volume fell 14% QoQ to $2.49T in Q3 2026 (Cryptorank). The $9.04B consensus is above Q2's $8.56B, so a revenue-miss headline is plausible again.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue was $8.56B against a $11.65-14.22B consensus, and headlines led with the miss; the stock moved -13.89% (CoinDesk 2026-08-05). In Q3 2025, record income outweighed revenue and the stock moved +8.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: Headline algorithms read the revenue line on this name even though it is gross notional. If a miss were expected, the consensus would have been cut toward Q2's level.
findings.independence: Q2 revenue miss and reaction: https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/08/05/galaxy-digital-shares-slip-5-after-second-quarter-results. This is a narrow proxy from a single secondary source; CCData's Q3 report was not found.

findings.finding: The Chief Accounting Officer, Robert Rico, left effective 2026-09-30, and Head of Accounting Policy Dritan Muneka became principal accounting officer. Q3 is the first quarter-close under the new PAO.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a quiet 8-K; the successor is an internal ex-KPMG controller, so the risk is small. It would only matter if the 10-Q is delayed or restated.

findings.finding: Director Douglas Deason bought 12,000 shares at $21.54 on 2026-08-12; the stock is now $15.47. Insider selling was limited to a 10b5-1 sale of 4,993 shares at $27.03 on 09-09.
findings.why_not_priced: This is small and old. It indicates that insiders were not selling into the drawdown.

findings.finding: A May 2026 resale shelf registers up to 265M Class A shares, mostly Novogratz's LP units (202M), plus 36.4M shares underlying exchangeable notes and 12.8M Capital Group private-placement shares bought at $36. This is a standing supply overhang, and those holders are under water.
findings.why_not_priced: Registration is not selling, and the shelf has been public since May. It weighs only if a holder uses a post-print window.

outside_window.finding: CoreWeave's own Q3 print, the direct read on its liquidity and capacity to pay Helios rent, comes after Galaxy's print window.
Helios Phase II data hall deliveries begin in Q2 2027 ($10.4B minimum contracted lease payments over 15 years).

baseline_tension: The findings lean positive against a -33% 20-day run-up and a balanced skew. That cuts against the drawdown's momentum, but not against the option market, which is paying slightly more for calls. The deep drawdown and rising short make a positive surprise mechanically larger, which is why the sign is kept, while p_up stays at 56 because the beat is inferred and the bar is disputed.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 + 5 + 6: the Q3 crypto-mark beat is an inference from public prices against a disputed bar on a name that sold two of three recent beats; cut from +3.0 to +2.0, and p_up from 57 to 56.
Rule 6 (inside guidance): Helios Phase I $80M is what the company guided; cut from +0.5 to +0.3.
Rule 5 (narrow proxy): the CEX-volume revenue proxy is a single secondary source; cut from -0.7 to -0.5.
Rule 7 / own caveat: the short interest is partly exchangeable-note hedging; cut from +0.7 to +0.5.
Rule 4: the $3.5B notes fund contracted Phase II leases, so they are not filed as a financing negative; the risk stays on tenant credit (finding 3, unchanged at -1.0).
Left standing: the Helios II tenant option (+0.5), CAO change, insider buy, resale shelf.
